title: Remove the Beads reader from the Work view
outcome: The Work view and the work memories read Engram only: the Beads reader, its types, its tests and fixtures, and the UI paths that show or merge a Beads snapshot are gone, and a project with no Engram binding shows the view's empty state rather than Beads data.
acceptance: A project with no .engram-project binding shows the Work view's empty state with a line saying no tracker is bound; a test covers it.

The Work view lists, sorts, filters and shows details for Engram items as before the change; the existing Engram Work-view tests pass unchanged except where they asserted Beads behaviour, and each such change is listed in this item's notes.
The full five-stage gate passes, in this item's named root, on a master tree that contains the landed change
src/work_visualizer_beads.rs, src/tests/work_visualizer_beads.rs and src/tests/fixtures/beads-reader.ps1 and .sh no longer exist, and no Rust or TypeScript source spawns bd or reads a .beads path.

completion.summary: Removed the Beads Work reader, types, tests and fixtures, leaving the Work view and memories Engram-only. Fresh independent acceptance evaluation df34a7917f864ba5ab892063857bc410 passed all five criteria, including the full five-stage gate on the landed master tree.
